title: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4-Spark on eight Sparks
evidence_scope: The settings of the four-Spark profile glm53-flash-nvfp4-spark-tp4 at tensor-parallel size 8 (MTP3 with native prefix caching, a 1,048,576-token context window and 40 GiB of KV cache per Spark), plus the csf checkpoint entry with the quantization, loader, KV size, W4A16 decode and draft MoE backend that local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD needs. Runs only on SIRCL ring sessions with NCCL off, on all eight Sparks of an eight-Spark ring; no image lock in this package lists it, so it installs only with a development image lock (v3) whose image carries the SIRCL layer and lists the profile. No installation of this profile has run on hardware; the four-Spark profile's settings served on SIRCL at TP4 on four-Spark lines of an eight-Spark ring through SIRCL's launcher. Not serving-qualified.
